safety: Back up your data before any repair step.
A swollen, hot, hissing or leaking battery: stop, power off, don't charge it, keep it away from anything flammable, and take it to a repair shop or battery recycler.
Opening a device can void its warranty. If it's under warranty or AppleCare/protection plan, contact the maker first.
Unplug the power and remove the battery where possible before opening anything.
Never open a power supply, charger or TV/console power unit: they hold dangerous charge even when unplugged.

symptoms.title: Storage is full or apps won't install

steps.do: Open Settings > Storage (Android) or Settings > General > iPhone Storage and see what uses the most space.
steps.why: Shows the biggest space users so you clear the right thing.

steps.do: Delete or offload apps you don't use, and clear large message attachments and downloaded videos.
steps.why: Media and old apps are usually most of the space.

steps.do: Back up photos to a computer or cloud, then remove them from the phone.
steps.why: Photos and videos are often the largest category.
Frees temporary files the system holds on to.

stop_if: Storage still shows full after deleting files and restarting

symptoms.title: Battery drains fast

steps.do: Check Settings > Battery for the apps using the most battery.
steps.why: One misbehaving app is a common cause.

steps.do: Check battery health: Settings > Battery > Battery Health (iPhone) or the maker's battery/device care page (many Android phones).
steps.why: Below about 80% of original capacity, runtime drops noticeably.

steps.do: Lower screen brightness, turn on battery saver/Low Power Mode, and update the system.
steps.why: Screen and old software are big drains.

steps.do: If health is low, get the battery replaced by the maker or a repair shop.
steps.why: A worn battery can't be fixed with settings.

stop_if: The back or screen is lifting or bulging
The phone gets hot while idle

symptoms.title: Won't charge or charges slowly

steps.do: Try a different cable, charger and wall outlet.
steps.why: Cables fail far more often than phones.

steps.do: Power off and gently remove lint from the charging port with a wooden or plastic toothpick. Never metal.
steps.why: Pocket lint packed in the port stops the plug seating fully.

steps.do: Restart the phone and check for system updates.
steps.why: Charging is managed by software too.

stop_if: The port is wet or corroded
The phone or charger gets very hot
It still won't charge with a known-good cable after cleaning

symptoms.title: Phone is slow or freezes

steps.do: Free storage until at least 10-15% is empty.
steps.why: A nearly full phone slows down.

steps.do: Update the system and apps; remove apps you don't recognise.
steps.why: Fixes bugs and removes heavy background apps.

steps.do: As a last resort, back up and factory reset.
steps.why: Clears software problems without touching hardware.

stop_if: Still freezing right after a factory reset (likely hardware)

symptoms.title: Phone gets hot

steps.do: Remove the case, stop gaming or charging, and let it cool out of direct sun.
steps.why: Heat plus charging is the usual cause.

steps.do: Check Settings > Battery for an app using lots of power in the background.
steps.why: Stuck apps keep the processor busy.

stop_if: It's hot while idle and not charging
